# SlopSearX routing profiles

Intent profiles map an agent's stated intent to engine scopes. Profiles are validated against the live registry at startup; sensitive intents (security) require an operator grant.

## web
- General-purpose web search across broad engines.
- categories: general

## news
- Recent news and headlines.
- categories: news

## science
- Papers, scholarly indexes, and scientific references.
- categories: science

## reference
- Encyclopedic and reference material.
- categories: reference

## code
- Source code, issues, and package registries.
- engines: github, stackexchange, pypi, npm, crates, rubygems, dockerhub

## social
- Discussion forums and social sources.
- engines: reddit, hackernews, brave, duckduckgo

## historical
- Archives and historical material.
- categories: historical
- engines: wikipedia, internetarchive

## jobs
- Job postings on ATS boards and general boards.
- engines: greenhouse, ashby, lever, brave, duckduckgo

## security
- Vulnerabilities, threat intelligence, and exposures.
- engines: cve, nvd, shodan, censys, crtsh, otx, abuseipdb, virustotal, urlhaus, epss, vulncheck, intelx, exploitdb, mitreattack, greynoise, hibp, dehashed
- sensitive: requires MCP_GRANT_SECURITY=1

## medical
- Clinical trials, biomedical literature, and health data.
- engines: pubmed, clinicaltrials, openfda, pubchem, uniprot

## finance
- Economic data and SEC filings.
- categories: finance

## packages
- Software package registries.
- categories: packages

## media
- Music, movies, and books.
- categories: music, movies, entertainment, books

## images
- Image search across media-capable engines.
- media types: image

## videos
- Video search across media-capable engines.
- media types: video

## legal
- Court cases and legal references.
- categories: legal

## geography
- Geocoding and place lookup.
- categories: geography
